title: CommissionVerdict
description: Outcome of one adjudication round at Gate C. Unanimity is required: ten PASS votes accept, one admissible DISSENT rejects the entire dossier. There is no partial acceptance and no state between ACCEPTED and REJECTED.

round.description: Round ceiling is 3; exhausting it escalates to human arbitration with the full ledger.

dossier_hash.description: Hash of the sealed Case Dossier assembled by the deterministic Clerk. All seats judge the identical record; the dossier is re-sealed every round.

bench_composition.description: Which seats were seated for this risk class. Governs seating only — never whether a seated seat's dissent is binding.

recusal_reason.description: A seat in SUCCESSION may not vote.

rationale.description: Populated ONLY on DISSENT. A PASS vote carries no rationale — a seat that agrees has nothing a downstream stage consumes, and rationale on ten seats across three rounds is the design's largest source of unread prose.

voted_blind.description: Seats vote in parallel without visibility of each other's votes or reasoning. Sequential or visible voting collapses the Commission to its first voter.

void_dissents.description: Ruled inadmissible by the Chair. Do not block; logged against the seat's calibration record.

contradiction_detected.description: Two open dissents whose remediation conditions cannot both hold. Routes to human arbitration without spending a remediation attempt.

dissent_ledger.description: Every dissent ever raised on this work order, across all rounds, with current status. Visible to seats on re-adjudication so a fix that resolves one dissent by violating another is caught immediately.

tenure_updates.description: Passings credited by this round. A passing is an admissible PASS vote; three passings trigger succession.
